g.title: inv
g.text: Checked invariants (TLC finite exploration + Apalache bounded)
• base SafetyInvariant holds for imported dumps: AvailableHasEvidence,
• ImportDisposition: tampered → rejected · tombstones → blobState none
• EntityOrder: case after customer · grant/dump after its case
• FingerprintPolicy: mismatched key ⇒ no issuable imported grant
• BundleStructure: manifest sets disjoint · bad ∈ promised ∪ {0}
• Crash: sealed/staging rows resume via base startup reconciliation

g.title: shared
g.text: Promote → quarantine → accept/reject is the SAME
machine live uploads use (base DumpLedger actions)
